1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea anual de hasta 60 cm de altura, de hojas alternas, simples, con nerviaciones muy evidentes, inflorescencia bastante ancha y flores de color blanco, amarillo, rojo o violeta; es ornamental. Amaranthaceae; Celosia cristata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Annual herbaceous plant up to 60 cm in height, with alternate, simple leaves having very evident venation, fairly broad inflorescence and flowers of white, yellow, red or violet color; it is ornamental. Amaranthaceae; Celosia cristata.
